t: In front of you is the bronze statue of Winston Churchill in Parliament Square, the work of the sculptor Ivor Roberts-Jones. Churchill was Prime Minister from 1940 to 1945, through the Second World War, and again from 1951 to 1955. He sat as a Member of Parliament for some sixty-two years between 1900 and 1964, which makes this a fitting place for him to stand. Roberts-Jones was a sculptor of Welsh descent, best known for his sculpted heads of notable people, including the violinist Yehudi Menuhin.
